scripts.build: mkdir -p www && wordplus-realtime copy www && cp shop/shop.css www/ && cp -R shop/avatars shop/products www/ && cp src/index.html www/ && esbuild src/app.js --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=www --define:SHOP_SERVER=\"${SHOP_SERVER:-http://localhost:3000}\"
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
